summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_292 brand-colour failures, plus a regression sweep. Method: the computed-style audit (/app/tests/colour_audit.js via /app/tests/colour_login.py) and screenshots at 1920x800 and 390x844, in light and dark mode. Theme was set through the toggle or localStorage 'theme'. RETEST RESULTS: (1) PASS: the /service-desk Team Performance hero stat values and the FTF ring are white on the dark card in light mode. (2) PASS: the /service-desk stat cards are readable in dark mode (white cards, dark text). (3) PASS: the /bfpo 'Needs attention now' and 'Sites requiring attention' headings are #1B1C1D on white in dark mode, desktop and mobile. (4) PASS: on a direct /login load the Sign In button is a filled Core Blue CTA with white text. (5) PARTIAL: the KPI icon is now #19CDFF, the CRM quick-create button is #19CDFF, and the PulseProUpgradeCta gradients are Core Blue / #0073A4 only. However, the landing gym-floor showcase overlay still uses rgba(20,24,31) (#14181F) at PulseLandingPage.js L1040. NEW ISSUES: invisible text in dark mode on the /staff-portal 'This month' card, the landing hero preview card, and the MOD login page (/MODService or ?portal=modservice) headline and form title. Regression sweep for /master-admin, /dashboard, /service-desk, /crm and /staff-portal on mobile in both themes: no text below 1.5:1 and no off-brand purple, navy or pink.

ui_bugs.issue: The h3 'This month' is white on white (1:1). RCA: Card() in StaffPortal.js L310-311 is hard-coded bg-white, while the dark override turns text-slate-900 white. This is the same pattern as the BFPO bug fixed this round. Fix: add data-theme="light" to the Card or page wrapper, as StaffDashboard.js does, or use theme-aware bg.

ui_bugs.component: MOD Service login (/?portal=modservice and /MODService, DARK theme in localStorage)
ui_bugs.issue: The h1 'One platform. / Always ready.' is white on #F7F7F7 (1.07:1) and the h2 'Service credentials' is white on white (1:1). Both are invisible. A user who has used dark mode on the commercial app sees a blank-looking headline. This was also seen on production modservice.pulsefitness.com. Fix: force data-theme="light" on the MODServiceLogin root, or use theme-aware bg.

ui_bugs.component: Pulse landing hero preview card (DARK mode, desktop)
ui_bugs.issue: 'Platform activity' and '£12,450' render #1B1D1D on #26292B (1.16:1), so they are invisible. RCA: PulseLandingPage.js ~L389-393 uses bg-white, which flips dark, but the text uses a fixed var(--color-surface-dark-panel-alt) that does not flip. The 'Saved via self-fix' tile has the same problem.

The 'Memberships, Marketing and CRM activate instantly...' text-zinc-300 resolves to #565B5E on #1B1C1D (2.48:1). It is dim but legible. In light mode it is fine. The on-dark helper seems to apply only under light theme.

issues: The navy-tinted overlay gradient rgba(20,24,31,0.7) is still present at PulseLandingPage.js L1040 (inline style). Retest item 5 is not fully done. Replace it with Soft Black rgba(27,28,29,0.7).

--rgb-info-ios is still '0 122 255' (iOS blue) at L228, while --color-info-ios is now #19CDFF. Hover and tint backgrounds in CRMApp/CRMSettings/CRMCPQ/CRMDocuments/CRMDemoTour/CRMLogin still tint iOS blue. Set it to 25 205 255.
--rgb-pulse-primary is '37, 99, 235' (Tailwind blue-600 navy-ish, and comma-separated, so rgb(var(..)/0.25) is invalid CSS) at L1495. It is used by PulseUpgradeRequestModal.js.

action_items: StaffPortal.js Card(): make the 'This month' (and other Card) headings readable in dark mode, e.g. data-theme="light" on the card.
MODServiceLogin.js: force the light theme on the root so the headline and 'Service credentials' are visible when localStorage theme=dark.
PulseLandingPage.js L389-393 hero preview: make the text and background flip together in dark mode, or pin the card to light.
PulseLandingPage.js L1040: replace rgba(20,24,31,...) with rgba(27,28,29,...).
index.css: set --rgb-info-ios to 25 205 255, remove or replace --rgb-accent-purple, and set --rgb-pulse-primary to '0 145 202' (space-separated).
critical_code_review_comments: Recurring pattern: hard-coded bg-white panels combined with global dark-mode text overrides produce white-on-white text. Fixes are applied page by page. Consider a global rule that resets text colours inside .bg-white when html is dark, or a shared Card primitive that is theme-aware.
The rgb channel tokens drifted from their hex counterparts (info-ios, pulse-primary). Generate both from one source.

success_rate.frontend: 4.5/5 retest items pass (item 5 partial); 3 new HIGH/MEDIUM invisible-text defects in dark mode

rca of the issue: The new dark-mode invisible text all comes from one cause. The global [data-theme=dark] overrides recolour text-slate-900/white tokens, but components hard-code bg-white, or use fixed CSS-var text colours on bg-white. So the text and background do not flip together.
